data.title: 宝多六花 · 散落耳机线床褥深处的私密自持 ·「听着你的语音消息……身体就擅自……」
data.description: 【六花卧室大床·深夜】戴着耳机听裕太留下的语音。六花只穿着宽松短袖和胖次躺在被窝里，耳机线在丰满的胸口起伏。手指在丰腴的大腿内侧缓缓滑动探入深处，喉咙里发出断断续续的鼻音——「笨蛋裕太……每次说话都那么温柔……害得我……一个人在床上做这种事……」
data.action: 仰卧床单耳机塞耳大腿分开自抚，肉腿蜷曲轻晃，闭目失神娇哼
data.promptProse: Lying sprawled across her messy bed with white earphones plugged into her ears, Rikka Takarada listens to your recorded voice notes on loop in the middle of the night. Her casual tee is bunched under her armpits, her soft, plump thighs spread wide as her hand glides deep between her dripping folds, fingers moving in slow, rhythmic sync with your voice. Her dark hair spreads across the sheets, blue eyes closed in heavy bliss as lazy whimpers slip past her swollen lips.
